# Senra Jobs

> Free directory of the 50 guests interviewed on the David Senra podcast, including founders and company leaders, their associated companies, and careers links. Join a great company, learn from inside, then build your own.

New roles from the 48 hours before the latest observation: https://senrajobs.com/new.json (page https://senrajobs.com/new, RSS https://senrajobs.com/new.xml). Pay is included only when the board posted it.
